events.title: SKY ON THE ROCK
events.description:
One day, a young girl visits the Over the Horizon office, saying that her wish is to ride in a hot air balloon.
• Participate in the SKY ON THE ROCK event and complete stages to get event items, which can be used to exchange for various rewards such as Recruit Vouchers and skill enhancement materials in the…
• Challenge Stage is available in SKY ON THE ROCK. Challenge the difficult boss stages to obtain various development materials!

events.title: 7-Day Login Event - FLIGHT D-DAY
events.description: Log in daily for up to 7 days during the event to get rewards. Get Recruit Vouchers and development materials when you log in for a total of 7 days.

events.title: December Mission Pass
events.description: After purchasing the Premium Mission Pass, complete daily missions to level it up and obtain Recruit Vouchers.

events.title: Crown - Naked King
events.description:
Obtain rewards such as Crown - Naked King, Advanced Recruit Vouchers, and Equipment Level-up Materials after 10 draws.
• If you have already obtained the costume Crown - Naked King, you can make a maximum of 9 draws, and the probability of obtaining the costume will be excluded.
• You can obtain gacha draws by using the special item, White Crown. White Crowns can be purchased from the Ticket Shop.

events.title: AFFECTION TRAIL
events.description:
Receive Traces of Love when you purchase designated items during the event. Collect enough Traces of Love to receive rewards.
• How to obtain Traces of Love: Purchase Lacrimosa Costume Gacha Ticket, Last Affection Costume Gacha Ticket, DARK MONK PASS, Step Up Package under Limited Pack, MARIA-n Pack, and New Nikke Upgrade…

events.title: Marian: Queen - Last Affection
events.description:
Obtain rewards such as Marian: Queen - Last Affection, Advanced Recruit Vouchers, and Equipment Level-up Materials after 10 draws.
• You can obtain gacha draws by using the special item Heartfelt Bouquet. Heartfelt Bouquet can be purchased in the Ticket Shop.
• As part of the 4th Anniversary event, receive Heartfelt Bouquet x6 in the Costume Gacha shop for free!

events.title: Raid Rush
events.description:
The EX Raid that we introduced in our previous Developer's Note has officially been named Raid Rush.
• As a boss raid event that will be held once a year, Raid Rush is designed for Commanders who enjoy challenging powerful bosses and competing for high scores.
• At the same time, we believe it's important to avoid requiring too much playtime or making the competition feel overly demanding.
